name: Sweet Halloween
source: You play as Aaron a cafe owner who is cheated on by their girlfriend just before the Halloween party that you and your friends where invited to. Even though your girlfriend was the one that got you those tickets, you decide to go anyways and have fun with your friends.  However, there is still a week before the party begins... and you might find something else within that time.
translation: 你扮演亚伦，一位咖啡馆老板，在你和你的朋友受邀参加万圣节派对之前，他被女友欺骗了。尽管你的女朋友是给你买票的，你还是决定去和你的朋友一起玩。然而，距离聚会开始还有一周……你可能会在这段时间内找到其他东西。
